map.W = 胜率，R = 盈亏比（平均盈利÷平均亏损）: W = win rate, R = risk-reward ratio (avg win / avg loss)
map.= (目标价 - 买入价) / (买入价 - 止损价): = (target price - buy price) / (buy price - stop-loss price)
map.理论上应满仓+杠杆（实务不建议）: Theoretically should go all-in + leverage (not advised in practice)
map.固定风险：股数 = 资金 × 风险% / |入场价 − 止损价|；凯利：f* =: Fixed risk: shares = capital × risk% / |entry price - stop price|; Kelly: f* = win rate - loss rate / risk-reward (half-Kelly = f* / 2)
map.固定分数法先确定单笔可承受亏损（资金×风险%），再除以每股风险得到仓位；凯利公式: The fixed-fraction method first sets the affordable loss per trade (capital × risk%), then divides by per-share risk to get the position; the Kelly formula gives the optimal bet fraction by win rate and risk-reward, and half-Kelly is commonly used in practice to reduce drawdown.
map.凯利公式假设可重复博弈，单次交易需谨慎。实务多用半凯利甚至更低，并设单笔风险上限: The Kelly formula assumes repeatable games; single trades need caution. In practice, half-Kelly or lower is used, with a per-trade risk cap (usually 1%-3%).
map.📚 深度解析：仓位规模与凯利公式: 📚 Deep Dive: Position Sizing and the Kelly Formula
map.按可承受风险金额与每股风险，算应买股数（固定风险法）。: Compute the shares to buy from the affordable risk amount and per-share risk (fixed-risk method).
map.凯利公式估算最优下注比例（f=(W−L)/W，W 胜率、L 赔率相关）。: The Kelly formula estimates the optimal bet fraction (f=(W-L)/W, W win rate, L odds-related).
map.账户 10 万、单笔风险 2%、每股风险 2 元: Account 100k, per-trade risk 2%, per-share risk 2 yuan
map.可承受损失=10 万×2%=2000 元；股数=2000/2=1000 股。即最: Affordable loss = 100k × 2% = 2000 yuan; shares = 2000/2 = 1000 shares. That is, buy at most 1000 shares; a 2 yuan/share stop-loss loses 2000.
map.胜率 55%、赔率 1（盈亏比 1:1）：f=(0.55×1−0.45)/1=0: Win rate 55%, odds 1 (risk-reward 1:1): f = (0.55×1-0.45)/1 = 0.10, full Kelly 10%, half-Kelly 5%. Half-Kelly is more robust, reducing ruin risk.
map.不冲突：凯利定\"账户比例\"，固定风险法定\"每股止损对应的股数\"。实务常取: No conflict: Kelly sets the "account fraction", fixed-risk sets the "shares per share stop-loss". In practice, half-Kelly + fixed-risk dual constraints are often used.
map.凯利公式的前提？: What are the assumptions of the Kelly formula?
map.假设独立重复赌博、概率与赔率已知且稳定。实盘概率估计有误差，故用半凯利或更保守比: Assumes independent repeated gambling with known and stable probabilities and odds. Live probability estimates have errors, so half-Kelly or more conservative fractions are used.
